question: Among the patients who have a normal platelet level, how many of them have other symptoms observed?
evidence: normal platelet level refers to PLT > 100 and PLT < 400; have other symptoms refers to Diagnosis is not null;
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND NOT T1.Diagnosis IS NULL
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

b.request: How many distinct patients (by ID) have a Laboratory record with PLT greater than 100 and less than 400 and a non-null Diagnosis in the Patient table?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.PLT > 100 AND L.PLT < 400 AND P.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

d.request: Among the patients with a normal platelet level (PLT > 100 and PLT < 400), how many distinct patient IDs have other symptoms observed (Diagnosis is not null), counting each ID only once?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.PLT > 100 AND L.PLT < 400 AND E.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
